implementation.identity_basis: Identical complete source/binary receipt sets and SHA-256 content hashes across both measured cohorts.
implementation.commit_note: The release commit is caller-declared. Quick12 may predate the commit while measuring the same staged sources and binaries. Captured build-marker commits remain unchanged; Git HEAD alone is not the measured implementation identity.

methodology: All seven raw event/host per-operation samples, full spans and calibrated replay counts are retained. No outlier rejection.
Cases run serially in two cohorts; same source/binary hashes are required. Quick12 is a subset, not additional independent coverage.
Math policy, dtype, algorithm, schedule and numerical contract define separate groups. No pooled overall win rate.
Quick/remainder splitting may separate strict/fast visits; their comparison is not ABBA or frequency-controlled causation.
Failed/unsupported/invalid-evidence pairs retain raw failure fields and receipts and contribute no performance ratio.
Native preallocated output and Torch functional allocation differ. Graph event spans can include host submission gaps.
Native compile and Torch compile-plus-first-call have different boundaries. No compiler speedup ratio.
Automatic SDPA common-envelope acceptance is not proof of identical internal precision; secondary strict errors remain visible.
Public path labels may be normalized/redacted; original result/source/binary/fixture/log content hashes are unchanged. PATH and GPU UUID are omitted.
